source: Chief Architect X18 Tutorial Guide, Kitchen and Bath Tutorials, pages 317-330

steps.step: Outlets: behind the refrigerator; left of the sliding door to the Deck, inside and out
(Weatherproof WP symbol outside; floor outlet when you click in the open; Height to Center 11 1/2")
steps.gap: Outlets outside aren't marked WP, and an outlet clicked in the open keeps the wall symbol; outlets default to 12" high. Row: EL-14

steps.step: Recess the Deck outlet into the wall (distance from wall -4", cuts the wall 4")
steps.gap: Electrical objects sit on the wall face; no distance from wall or wall cut. Row: EL-14

steps.step: GFCI outlet under the left Kitchen window: placed over the counter it starts at 43"; set 39"
(height)
(Outlets over a countertop start at counter height)
steps.gap: New outlets don't notice the countertop; set the height yourself. Row: EL-14

steps.step: Wall Elevation: turn the outlet horizontal (don't regenerate its plan symbol)
steps.gap: Electrical objects have no rotation about the wall's face (portrait/landscape). Row: EL-14

steps.step: Counter outlets: centre on the sink base, then move 72" and Transform/Replicate three copies 48" apart
Copy/Paste one more GFCI outlet on the Dining wall, left of the refrigerator
Library: a 220V floor receptacle at the island range; a garbage disposal outlet behind the sink base
(Floor 220V symbol; disposal outlet)
steps.gap: One 240V outlet symbol; no floor-mounted or appliance (disposal) outlets. Row: EL-13

steps.step: Switches: right of the sliding door to the Deck, right of the doorway into the Dining room
(Air switch on the countertop for the disposal)
Two more switches beside the Deck one, then Make Ganged Electrical Block; a gang by the Dining doorway too
(Make Ganged Electrical Block)
steps.gap: No ganged electrical blocks. Row: EL-09

steps.step: Electrical Connection: the Deck switch to the Deck wall light and on to the Deck ceiling light
Three-way: the middle Deck switch through the four right-hand Kitchen can lights to the Dining doorway switch
(Connections drawn as splines from fixture to fixture)
steps.gap: Wiring is drawn switch to each fixture; there are no editable connection splines chaining fixtures. Row: EL-01

steps.step: Data and security: detectors, alarms and jacks from the library
(Jacks, alarms and other special symbols)
steps.gap: Smoke detectors and junction boxes only; no data jacks, alarms or security symbols. Row: EL-13

steps.step: Electrical legend: an Electrical Schedule in the Legends and Notes CAD detail, titled Electrical Legend, with scaled pictures
(pictures)
(Title; schedules in a CAD detail)
steps.gap: Schedules have the kind's title and sit in the plan. Row: EST-31

steps.step: Make a Copy as Chic Cottage-Electrical; Project Browser folder Kitchen and Bath Tutorials holding the revisions
